findings.evidence: Two-dot log and three-dot diff can disagree after partial merges; choose deliberately and state the comparison.
findings.fix: Extend the evidence-scope gotchas with the other non-obvious git traps: shallow clones have no merge-base for three-dot diffs, and `git show` on a merge commit shows only the squashed conflict resolution
